payload.note: The exact full-phase-space density has universal single-channel behavior 9/(8s_B^2). A positive-energy rank-five physical point has exactly one transverse zero, giving a positive (t-3/5)^-2 pole and proving that the ordinary exclusive phase-space integral diverges locally. A detector or inclusive distribution is mandatory and remains open. Evidence: REVERSE_PHYSICS_BT_SIX_POINT_PHASE_SPACE_POLE_OBSTRUCTION_V1.
